Patient Demographics — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Name, date of birth, sex assigned at birth and contact details for a patient intake form.

Open in Builder

Scoring

No scoring — a data-collection fragment.

Questions

  1. First name
  2. Last name
  3. Date of birth
  4. Sex assigned at birth
    • Female
    • Male
    • Unknown
  5. Phone number
  6. Email address
  7. Home address

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “Patient Demographics”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
